name: kreaton
description: Real-time Authorised Push Payment (APP) fraud interceptor and mule-chain tracer for UPI-style payments.
author: Team Kreaton

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @kreaton/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @kreaton/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/sim && npm run typecheck -w @kreaton/web
scripts.artefacts: npm run seed && npm run evaluate && npm run adversarial && npm run modelcard
